request.purpose: Policy-making: planning hospital capacity and care pathways for the coming years.
request.question: How many adults with obesity are there per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Report per region: adults with obesity and patients with sleep apnoea.
